trans_from_rgb — 2D color op

• Data kinds: color → color

• Call: fullseye.apply(img, "trans_from_rgb", a=0.5, b=0.5) (the 2-D model is one image plus two scalar knobs a,b∈[0,1])

• HALCON equivalent: trans_from_rgb (the HALCON reference is a useful guide to its meaning and parameters)

Usage

Converts an RGB image to another color space (HSV / Lab / YUV / XYZ). Corresponds to HALCON's `trans_from_rgb` (conversion from RGB color space to an arbitrary color space).

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.
